---
title: Built-in Themes
description: Overview of the 5 built-in themes included with Huba.
---

Huba ships with 5 built-in themes. The default theme is **Claude**.

## Claude (default)

Warm dark theme with rust and orange accents, inspired by Claude's branding. Features earthy tones that are easy on the eyes during long sessions.

![Huba - Claude theme](/docs/themes/claude.webp)

## Catppuccin

Based on the Catppuccin Mocha color palette. Uses soft pastel colors with mauve accents for a cozy, low-contrast aesthetic.

![Huba - Catppuccin theme](/docs/themes/catppuccin.webp)

## GitHub

Inspired by GitHub's Dark theme. Uses familiar blue accents and a neutral dark background, well-suited for developers who spend time on GitHub.

![Huba - GitHub theme](/docs/themes/github.webp)

## Contrast

High-contrast accessibility theme with a pure black background and bright primary colors (yellow, green, cyan). Designed for maximum readability and screen reader compatibility.

![Huba - Contrast theme](/docs/themes/contrast.webp)

## Grayed

Monochrome grayscale theme. Uses entirely shades of gray for a minimalist, distraction-free aesthetic.

![Huba - Grayed theme](/docs/themes/grayed.webp)
